steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Comparing requires identifying both similarities and differences — not just one or the other | Key Fact: Use linking words: 'similarly', 'in contrast', 'whereas', 'both', 'however' to show comparison clearly | Key Fact: Always compare the same element — for example, compare use of dynamics in both works | Key Fact: Evaluating means making a judgement about effectiveness, supported by specific evidence

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from comparing &amp; evaluating dance, and one past-paper question.
